label: Sint-Martinus Church, Heers
note: robot-measured spatial IRs (Earthworks M30 at the centre and 6 electret capsules) at 152 positions in the nave, 167 files with the repeats; each file holds every loudspeaker twice: m0/m1, m2/m3 and m4/m5 the Genelec 8341A in front of the organ at y = +1.35, 0 and -1.35 m, m6/m7 the one behind the organ (the SOFA files list four 8341A; the record text's 7360A is likely a slip, as these IRs are full band), m8/m9 the omnidirectional GSR behind the altar (Zenodo 22686848). No reverberation time is stated; the mid T30 of 2.2 s fits the centre times of 0.11-0.18 s in the authors' overview PDF
